minutes.headline: Selectmen said the cancelled Thanksgiving football game is the school committee's call, and approved a December toll.
minutes.summary: Most of the meeting was public comment from residents upset that the school committee cancelled the Thanksgiving football game after racial graffiti was found at a student's home. The board said it has no authority over that decision and sent residents to the school committee. The board also heard a regional dispatch review from the fire and police chiefs, set a snow date for the special town meeting, and approved a music program toll.

what_happened.line: Most of the meeting was resident comment urging the board to reverse the school committee's cancellation of the Thanksgiving football game; the board referred them to the school committee.
The board approved a voluntary toll for the LHS music program on December 21, subject to talks with the police chief and DPW.
The board set Thursday, January 9, 2014 at 7 pm as the snow date for the January 7 special town meeting.
The police chief said a new radio repeater frequency and a voice over IP phone system would be costly, as the board reviewed the regional dispatch transition.
The board took no action on the net metering credit agreement with Townsend and will wait for Townsend's response.

why_it_matters: Regional dispatch equipment needs, such as radio repeaters and phones, are not fully funded yet and may show up as capital or operating requests that go to the town budget, mostly taxes.
The school project warrant and ballot question will go to voters, and the board's recommendation on it is still to be decided.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the two non-procedural votes and most warrant and radio figures, but differ on the names and titles of several attendees and on a few decision details. The main difference is the school project warrant item: ours says a recommendation will be discussed on December 3, while the official minutes say the warrant description will be circulated and printing moved out until after that meeting.
